note: P3 content — the FEED THE RIFT window names executions[0].

executions.name: Return to Sender
executions.script: He taps the loser's chest with two fingers, almost kind — and discharges the entire Bank at once. The camera stays on his sad face while, behind him, the silhouette leaves through the arena wall in a cone of red. He hard-hats the dust off. 'Nothing personal. It was yours.'

executions.name: Load-Bearing
executions.script: He hoists them overhead like a beam, walks to the Rift-scar, and presses — the bone-cam shows the spine accepting a building's worth of stored weight for exactly one frame. What he sets down, gently, is not load-bearing anymore.

desecration.name: Overtime
desecration.script: The hug simply doesn't stop at the round-end bell; the freeze-frame is the crowd flinching.

overdrive.name: STRUCTURAL FAILURE
overdrive.script: He opens the Bank all the way: grabs the opponent and releases every stored newton through them into the arena — the background visibly demolishes in a controlled-implosion wave, and the opponent is the charge.
